title: Ukraine says it plans to share nearly four years of combat data, including millions of hours of drone footage, with allies to help train AI models (Max Hunder/Reuters)
summary: Max Hunder / Reuters: Ukraine says it plans to share nearly four years of combat data, including millions of hours of drone footage, with allies to help train AI models — Ukraine will establish a system allowing its allies to train their artificial intelligence models on Kyiv's valuable combat data collected throughout …
